demo.title: Demonstration controls
demo.description: Explore simulated scenarios and restore the data whenever needed.
demo.contractError: The received response is invalid. Reset the demonstration to try again.
demo.requestError: The simulation could not be queried. Reset the demonstration to try again.
demo.startupError: The demonstration could not start. Check whether storage and service workers are allowed.
demo.notice: All data is fictional. Applying a scenario resets the simulation state; your language preference is preserved.
demo.effect_default: Restores the data and default behavior.
demo.effect_empty: Shows a catalog with no results.
demo.effect_sold-out: Sells out the Emerald Ape 1/50 edition.
demo.effect_variable-latency: Searches respond at different times; the latest search must prevail.
demo.effect_offline: Simulates a network failure during requests.
demo.effect_timeout: Delays the response beyond the request timeout.
demo.effect_malformed-response: Returns invalid data to exercise contract validation.
demo.effect_malformed-event: Sends an invalid event that must be ignored.
demo.effect_pending-order: Resets the data and prepares a pending order. Sign in as colecionador to inspect it without confirming payment.
demo.effect_session-expired: Expires only your current session and opens login with return to this page.
demo.effect_favorites-failure: Fails to save favorites for your user. The heart changes immediately and rolls back after failure.
demo.effect_favorites-ready: Restores saving favorites without deleting data or signing out.
demo.effect_cart-empty: Empties only the current cart without signing out.
demo.effect_coupon-invalid: Makes the API reject coupons for this cart. Apply a code in the summary.
demo.effect_coupon-expired: Makes the API treat coupons in this cart as expired.
demo.effect_quote-failure: Fails to calculate the quote while preserving cart items.
demo.effect_cart-price-change: Updates the first cart NFT through Socket.IO and requires review of the new quote.
demo.effect_cart-stock-change: Sells out the first cart edition through Socket.IO. Remove it to continue.
demo.effect_cart-ready: Removes cart faults. Items and catalog changes are preserved.
demo.effect_cart-slow: Delays cart reads and writes to inspect loading and click prevention.
